'''2014 Worlds Reset Beta Mitch Nieland LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mitch Nieland]] at [[2014 World Championship Reset Beta]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Mitch Nieland]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 World Championship Reset Beta]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Podrace Prep]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/worlds-2014-reset-beta-event-mitch-nieland-ls-wys-podracing/ PC list]
